name: Metaball Field Evaluation
aliases: Metaball Field Evaluation — GPU Field Generation
definition: Evaluates a dynamic scalar field composed of three moving metaballs (spheres) for density calculation at a point $(x,y,z)$.
summary: Metaball Field Evaluation generates dynamic 3D scalar volumes by summing inverse-distance contributions from moving spheres, creating organic merging shapes distinct from general implicit field composition.
